prompts.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Create a realistic architectural top-down game-map concept for Open Channel Offensive, a grounded industrial-office 3v3 tactical FPS at night. Input is a strict floorplan/layout reference, not the desired final art style. Camera STRAIGHT DOWN / ORTHOGRAPHIC, roof removed, no isometric tilt. Preserve the reference building footprint, relative room sizes, ALL room partitions and existing doorway gaps, outdoor approach area, and both bomb-site rooms. All walls, interior AND exterior AND courtyard walls, are destroyable and reinforceable by players; depict every wall as consistent modular plaster/industrial wall construction with subtle panel seams. No permanent concrete cores or indestructible structural walls, no specially designated breach panels and no pre-installed reinforcement panels. All walls intact in this concept. Gray reference rectangles are sparse equipment props; turn them into plausible server racks, cabinets, workshop machinery or loading crates while keeping route space clear. Do not add lots of additional furniture. Dark outside band is walkable exterior approach, not more indoor rooms. Dashed outer boundary, graph grid, route line, ATK icon, header/footer, all blueprint labels must disappear. Include ONLY two clear painted floor stencil letters: A in the cyan reference site room and B in the amber reference site room. Keep the site positions EXACT. The letters should be readable but restrained, no other text or UI. Atmosphere: warm wall lamps and desk lighting, cool blue night spill from windows; clean readable medium-dark floors, worn carpet/rubber, pale modular wall panels, dark metal equipment, minimal clutter. Even ambient fill everywhere, every room readable, no pitch black corners, no people, guns, logos or watermarks. Entire building and outdoor approaches visible, balanced square-ish composition with a slim dark margin. Architectural concept art, not gameplay screenshot. Keep floorplan topology and two distinct sites unmistakable. SWITCHBOARD layout: 30x24 m building. Top row: Reception west, Meeting middle, site A Server northeast. Middle row: Office west, broad Connector center, Electrical east. Bottom row: site B Workshop southwest, Archive middle, Loading southeast. Site A and B are in opposite diagonal corners. Attacker staging outdoors southeast. Palette of soft warm office light with subdued blue-gray corridor floors and concrete loading apron. Make A a sparse server room and B a workshop, not another server room.
